statewide network mostly in forested and fire-prone regions
evidence.quote: Wisconsin once had a vast fire tower lookout network, mostly in the forested and most fire prone regions of the state.
At the height of their use, 119 towers dotted the landscape.

sources.title: Connecting the dots: the fire towers of Wisconsin

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is the Forest Fire Lookout Association list (name, coordinates, Tower Gone, no register number). The village pages describe the village, not the tower, and are used only for the name's origin. No build date, design, height, staffing, fires or description of the current site was found in the two web searches or the pages read. A TopoZone Sawyer County tower index lists an entry called 'Radisson' with no description; its type and place were not confirmed, so it is not used. The story is short on purpose and below the usual 120-word floor. Re-check with the Sawyer County Record or DNR fire-tower records if a fuller story is wanted.
